scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n server,ngrok -c blue,magenta "go run ./cmd/server" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8080 && ngrok http --url=slang-compound-landmass.ngrok-free.dev 8080"
scripts.test:live: dotenv -e .env -- env MONI_LIVE_TESTS=1 LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT=live-test go test ./cmd/server -run Live -count=1 -v
scripts.eval:serve: dotenv -e .env -- env MONI_EVAL_SERVE=1 LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT=eval go test ./cmd/server -run TestEvalServer -count=1 -v -timeout 0
scripts.bench:llm: dotenv -e .env -- env MONI_BENCH=1 go test ./internal/extract -run TestBenchModels -count=1 -v -timeout 0
